Mode latihan: pisah dari ujian resmi, pembahasan langsung per soal → participant/js/ujian.js
Rate limiter login: hubungkan api/rate_limiter.php ke api/auth.php → 1 baris
Bookmark soal: kolom is_bookmarked di jawaban_user → ujian.js + soal.php
priority_2_medium_effort: Countdown jadwal ujian resmi (CPNS, IPDN, UTBK) di dashboard peserta
Sertifikat printable: template HTML/PDF, QR mandiri, halaman verify publik
OTP verifikasi HP saat registrasi via WhatsApp/SMS → api/auth.php
priority_3_high_effort: Forum diskusi / tanya jawab per topik materi
CAT adaptive testing aktif di frontend (backend IRT sudah ada)

key_insights.application_purpose: Modern online exam system for Indonesian civil service exams (Sekolah Kedinasan, CPNS, UTBK/SNBT) with comprehensive features including RBAC, gamification, AI-powered analytics, learning paths, expert system, and dynamic topic-based question generation
key_insights.current_maturity: Production Ready v2.0 with extensive feature set including 66 database tables, 15 API endpoints, comprehensive admin panel with content generation, system maintenance tools, topic-database integration for better question categorization and search, and comprehensive learning materials from internet research
key_insights.development_focus: Currently focusing on social learning features, advanced proctoring, PWA enhancements, certification tracking, and admin panel refactoring for better maintainability
key_insights.technical_strengths: Well-structured PHP native backend with REST API, comprehensive database schema with migrations and junction tables for topic relationships, automated testing with Puppeteer, Python scripts for data import, PWA support with service worker, dynamic topic selection for AI question generation, comprehensive learning materials from internet research
key_insights.unique_features: AI-powered expert assistant, content generation system with topic-based categorization, comprehensive gamification (XP, badges, achievements, daily challenges, streak), learning paths with prerequisites, advanced analytics dashboard, topic-database integration for better question organization and search, comprehensive learning materials from internet research for all exam categories
